seasonRows.notes: MU 6-9 is not listed in the Region 6 moose rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from District of Kitimat, about 130 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.87136, -127.22933, pull off on Glacier (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.1 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 277 m, about 130 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 90 m W of the spot at 1,156 m (53.83936, -127.28641). Water: unnamed wetland 90 m E (estimate).
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-9, Region 6. Season: no general open season (synopsis page 50, 95%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-16, closures 2026-10-16.
